row.team_price_text: Core: free to start; usage-based pricing via sales
row.evidence: Smartling's SCIM page says "Smartling runs that lifecycle through its identity-provider integration rather than a SCIM endpoint" (OIDC or SAML SSO with Auto-registration on first login).
row.notes: Status changed from unknown to none: a Smartling page (last reviewed 2026-09-20) states that user lifecycle runs through OIDC/SAML SSO with Auto-registration, SSO Enforcement and manual removal rather than a SCIM endpoint, while telling teams that require SCIM 2.0 to confirm with their representative. Auto-registration is JIT (Requester or Project Manager role), so this is JIT-only and may be reclassified at merge. The pricing page moved from /pricing (now 404) to /plans and shows Core (free to start) and Enterprise (book a meeting); pricing is by translation type, volume and automation, so no per-user prices. SSO is for Enterprise customers per the SSO article. The REST API's People endpoint only returns user information for given user IDs; there is no user create/remove API.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: SSO cell on the plans page is not checked for Core (icon only).

scim.notes: Vendor says lifecycle runs through the IdP integration rather than a SCIM endpoint; it also says SCIM-requiring teams should confirm availability with their representative.

capabilities.notes: People API only looks up user information by user UID.

limitations.text: Growth/Core API access is limited to Authentication, Files, Jobs, Job Batches and Context endpoints (People not included).

fallbacks.other_sync: Users Report (CSV/PDF) for reconciliation; SSO Enforcement per domain
